lines.text: Ahab assembles the prophets on Mount Carmel, and Elijah says the God who answers by fire is God.
The prophets of Baal call on Baal from morning until noon, but no one answers them.
Elijah repairs the altar of the LORD, taking eleven stones, one for each tribe of the sons of Jacob.
After the fire falls, the people say the LORD is God, and Elijah brings Baal's prophets to the Kidron Valley.
A small cloud rises from the sea, heavy rain falls, and Elijah runs ahead of Ahab to Jezreel.
